verdict.rationale: Plausible's self-hosted Community Edition lets an organization run the whole stack on infrastructure of its own choosing, which indirectly gives full control over data residency, and its no-cookie/no-personal-data posture reduces residency risk generally. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of a region-selection feature (e.g., EU vs US data centers) for the hosted/cloud product, so residency control for most users is only achievable via self-hosting rather than a built-in choice. Missing for 10: explicit cloud-hosted region/residency selection option, official docs describing data center locations, independent confirmation of residency guarantees for SaaS customers.
